name: Exploded View
summary: An assembled object separates along a shared axis to reveal the relationship between its parts.
cautions: Use consistent orientation and leave room for the labels.

name: Comparison Wipe
summary: A moving divider reveals a second sample at the same scale, then holds both in view.
cautions: Keep scale and framing fixed; identify both sides in the settled frame.

name: Route Trace
summary: A line draws a route across a fixed plan and resolves at a marked destination.
cautions: Keep the start, endpoint and landmarks legible after the line settles.
